lines.en: : To the promised land!
So, apparently the promised land is the Miyamura family porn shop — a development I should have expected given recent developments in Miku as a person.

And while the majority of those developments probably entered her attached to my fingertips, it is my responsibility as an adult to make sure that she experiences this brave new world as responsibly as possible.
: They keep the hardcore stuff in the back. That’s the place you want to be.
: Whaddya mean by “hardcore stuff?” This about that butt thing I was mentionin’ earlier? Cause I ain’t gotta see that. Just thought it was neat.
: I think that, when it comes to porn, it’s best to just experience things yourself so that you don’t go in jaded by expectations placed on you by others.
: Take me, for example. I habitually masturbate to images of cartoon ponies. And I probably never would have done that if someone told me it was wrong beforehand.
: Sorry, did I hear that right? Cartoon ponies?
: Yeah. You heard that correctly.
: I’ve been on a bit of an Applejack kick lately.
: Like the cereal? You and Uta eatin’ breakfast together now?
: No. Like the horse, Applejack — the most dependable pony this side of Ponyville. A proud farm pony who ain’t afraid to get her hooves dirty.
: Now, I learned from Maki that it ain’t right to bash what other people are into, but I ain’t so sure about this one, Sensei.
: It’s fine. I’ll show you the light eventually. You’ll understand one day.
: Oh, I get it. It’s like choosin’ a favorite sports team. It’s better to pick for yourself instead of just doin’ what ‘yer folks want ya to do, right?
: I don’t know. You should be very aware by now that I’m not a sports person. But I am a porn person, which means you should take everything I say very seriously while we’re here.
: Roger that, Sensei. My fate is in your hands.
: Right now, our main goal is to think of an objective. Why are we here? What is it we seek within these walls today? Knowledge? Pleasure? Or perhaps...Student Council Punishment Games Volume 9?
: Wait, volume 9? Do I gotta watch the other ones first?
: No, but you probably should. The storyline is actually extremely gripping and dramatic. And the main character looks and acts a lot like Makoto.
: So she’s like, one of them straight-laced, smartypants types with a secret freaky side?
: That’s right. And she won’t stop until she’s been punished by everyone in town.
: Won’t stop what?
: You know...just...she won’t. Don’t ask questions.
: How the heck am I supposed to learn about sex and porn and stuff if I can’t ask questions? Ain’t you supposed to be my tour-guide on the way to Bonerville?
: I’m not allowed in Bonerville anymore. Everyone else was getting jealous.
: That’s fine. You just gotta get me to the gate. I can figure out the rest.
: I’m not going to drop you off at Bonerville, Miku. You’re not ready yet.
: Damn it, Sensei! Enough with your games! I’m finally ready to start consumin’ adult media and I ain’t gonna be held back by a man who ain’t allowed in Bonerville!
: Hm? Bonerville?
: Are you two planning a vacation to my favorite place on earth without me? That’s so mean.
: Maki! Sensei won’t-
: Whaaaaaaaaa...
: Big, right?
: Maki, what is that?
: Horse cock!
: I could finally please Applejack...
: You sure could! Because we all know she likes ‘em big.
: Maki...you too? You’re one of us?
: I appreciate all porn equally! That’s my job, after all!
: Why?
: Because some people are into that sort of thing. I don’t know.
: You’re one of those people, aren’t you?
: Maybe I am. Maybe I’m not. What difference does it make? A dildo’s a dildo’s a dildo! And if somebody wants to put something inside of them, it’s my job to help.
: Just not physically. That’s a different profession. And it costs extra. And I’m going to make you sign a waiver.
: I’m scared.
: That’s just because you’re not ready yet! But one day, when the time is right, and your curiosity has advanced far past normal human penises, you’ll know where to come for something different.

: I have demons and ogres and stuff in stock too. Any dick you could ever imagine, I’ve pulled out of a box. That’s right, Miku. Whether it be Bad Dragon or the Official Dildo Saber, I’ve got anything you-
: Maki, I understand that you’re a salesman at heart, but you might want to remember who you’re selling things to.
: Oh, good point. You should walk away so I can teach her about all of this girl-to-girl. There’s no need for your kind here, penis-haver.
: I think I’m just gonna see what Makoto’s doin’ instead...
: You two have fun with...your horse...
: Darn it. Nobody ever wants to have the horse cock talk.
: Can you really blame them? And also, why are you holding it like a rifle?
: Better question — where the hell have you been lately?
: Is that really a better question? Because I think mine is-
: I’m being serious right now, Akira. I heard from Sara that you were back, but I sure didn’t expect you to come wandering into my shop like nothing ever happened.
: Are you okay? Do you need anything? Free horse cock?
: There’s no way you’d give that to me for free.
: Yeah, this baby’s like 60,000 yen. But still.
: If there’s anything you need-
: Just time. That’s all. I’ve barely talked to anyone lately, so please don’t take it personally that I haven’t really dropped by.
: That little factoid makes it even stranger that you’re showing up with Miku. But I guess if you two are just here looking for Makoto-
: Oh, no. Miku said she was taking me to the promised land and, next thing I knew, we were here.
: Ah! I’ve never been this proud in my life!
: You know you have an actual daughter, right?
: Yes, but she simply doesn’t understand.
: Miku, though...she’s been all sorts of curious lately, hasn’t she?
: Not like I’d know. This is the first time I’ve really hung out with her since Halloween.
: Well, without getting into any of the graphic details, I think her time has finally come. And without anybody else to show her the ropes, she and I might really have to talk soon.
: But hey! On the bright side, it seems like whatever Makoto had going on with her mystery-boyfriend has either fizzled out or she’s just gotten really good at hiding it! So either way, yay!
: Yeah...that’s great news.
: We have to leave.
: Everything okay, dear?
: I’ve seen things I can never unsee.
: Oh...She wasn’t studying in there, was she?
: I don’t wanna talk about it.
: But what about the promised land? Don’t you want Maki to help you start exploring the world of-
: Nope.
: I don’t want anything ever again.
: Hah. I told her to stop doing that in there. But girls will be girls, I guess.
: Yeah...Anyway, I’m going to follow Miku. But it was nice seeing you again, Maki. I’ll...be around.
: You know where to find me.
: Hang in there, Akira.
: Welp, I’m sure glad that’s over.
: Part of me wants to ask exactly what you saw, but the other part of me thinks it might be better if I just never find out.
: Yeah, I’m gonna say you’re better off without this forbidden knowledge, Sensei.
: Well...now what, then? Are we just going home?
: Idunno. I kinda wanna keep hangin’ out if you’re okay with it. Don’t get many chances to see ya anymore since you stopped comin’ to school and the dorms.
: I’ll be back eventually. I just need to stop wanting to die first.
: Please don’t die. I ain’t ready for even more tragedy yet. And, ya know what? I probably never will be. So just stay alive for the rest of forever, okay?
: I’ll...see what I can do, Miku.
: Thanks, I...guess...
: Uhh...
: Is everything-
: Mm!
: Oh. You wanted to hold hands.
: It’s dark...
: And nobody else is around, so you ain’t gotta worry about us bein’ seen or anything...
: And maybe I just kinda...you know...wanted to...
: It’s fine. I don’t mind. In fact, I find it really cute when you act like this.
: Shut up. I know you’re only sayin’ that to mess with me. I ain’t cute at all.
: I’m not, though.
: You don’t need to wear dresses and stuff to be cute, Miku. You’ve always been cute. And whenever you let your guard down around me, it really shows.
: It’s only because it’s you that I can-
: Miku? Is that you over there?
: Ah! What?! Maybe?! Yes!
: Oh! Sensei, you’re here too.
: It’s really funny. In the dark, it kind of looked like you two were holding hands.
: Hahahah! That Karin! Always such a friggin’ kidder! Me and Sensei holdin’ hands! Hahaha! What is this?! Some kinda rom-com?! Hahahah!
: Miku, are you okay? Your face is beet-red.
: Oh! Hahah! Yeah!
: That’s just from all the porn.
: Running! I don’t know why I said that other thing! We were running! Right, Sensei?
: Yes, but only because it’s Karin and she’s the last bit of purity I have in this world now that Sana’s been taken from me.
: Huh? What happened with Sana?
: Yeah, what happened with Sana?
: Wait, who is Sana again?
: Short girl. Black hair. Used to have one eye, now she has two.
: Aww. I love stories of people overcoming obstacles. Good for her.
: Nothing happened with Sana. I’m just talking out of my ass again.
: Better than doin’ that other thing with it at least.
: What’re you doin’ out here this late, though? Ain’t you normally home around this time?
: I was out with some of my friends from the softball club and decided to take the long way home today. And I’m glad I did since I got to run into you guys.
: How come you’re walking around in the dark, though? Isn’t that a little dangerous?
: Shouldn’t we be the ones sayin’ that to you? ‘Least I’ve got an escort. You’re out here by yourself. And with bazongas like that, you’re way more of a target than I’d ever be.
: What’s a “bazonga?”
: It’s slang for your kind and gentle demeanor.
: Yeah. And your boobs are huge too.
: M-Miku?! You can’t say things like that in front of a teacher! You’re going to get in trouble!
: There are a lotta things I shouldn’t be doin’, Karin. But ya girl’s headin’ down a long and lonely road full of sausage and sweat and she ain’t got no more time for censorship.
: Nonsense. There is always time for censorship as we are far too young to be exposed to material that could begin to shape the world in a negative-
: Blah, blah, blah. Sensei, what are your thoughts on censorship?
: I am your accountant after all. And some would say that's like having no hair whatsoever.
: I don't actually like the third season of Seinfeld.
: (Airplane noises)
: Pass.
: Pass?
: Sensei just knows that censorship makes everything better and that the world would be a happier, sunnier place if we would all just watch daytime television.
: Okay, forget the censorship thing since it’s clear all three of us ain’t gonna get on the same wavelength for it. But that don’t mean we can’t still find a way to have fun.
: Miku, it’s almost 9:00. How am I supposed to have fun after 9:00? That’s pajama-time. If I don’t get the recommended eight hours of sleep, how am I supposed to function tomorrow?
: Idunno. Sleep later?
: How dare you...
: I taught you better than this.
: Sensei, you on board for some pajama-time fun-time?
: Probably not the kind Karin would be interested in.
: Well, I’ve got the perfect idea. And it’s one I’m sure nobody sees comin’.
: I’m not taking Karin to the promised land.
: And I’m still not convinced it’s okay to walk away from pajama-time.
: The three of us...are doin’ karaoke!
: Uhh-
: Oh, I love karaoke! But I thought the noises would-
: Don’t worry! I’ve been practicin’ with stuff like that and I think I’ll be okay! Maybe! I don’t know! It’s kind of a test!
: Guys-
: If it’s just for a little while, I don’t mind. I didn’t bring any money with me, though.
: That’s fine! Sensei’s an adult! He can pay!
: I don’t really want to-
Miku’s affection has increased to [miku_love]!
